summary: Iteration 5 (v3, AI removed). Tested backend and frontend on mobile (390x844). Backend: the new suite test_v3_api.py passed 13/13. It covers home live/upcoming, Potenza Live reports (auth, zone validation, confirm once, self-confirm 400, guest 401, item-linked reports), Spotlight (needs a 'here' vote, guest 401, wave goes to the recipient inbox with kind 'wave', duplicate 409, self-wave 400, un-voting removes the user, /spotlight/places), fuel sort/price validation (0.5-4) and admin simple CRUD for fuel/info, proposals/contact/newsletter (guest, deduplicated, case-insensitive), /me/newsletter, register with newsletter:true, admin inbox/done/delete/CSV, post save toggle and /me/saved-posts, guest report then admin 'resolve', archived events (hidden from /items, /vivi and item GET; listed in admin status=archived), event_window default end (23:59, or 04:00 next day if start >=20:00), /surprise (<=3 unique items), and AI/admin-replies endpoints returning 404/405. Regression: test_v2_api + test_vivi_api pass 35/35 when run serially (-n 0), after updating 3 outdated assertions. Frontend: all requested flows were tested and work. Explore live box (guest Segnala opens the login prompt), dual ranking tabs, Sorprendimi plus reroll, Spotlight chip (guest gets the login prompt; logged-in users see places with active people), Benzina chip goes to /info-utili, newsletter subscribe, footer link to /contatti. '+' sheet shows 3 blocks plus Proponi/Contattaci. Live report via '+' appears in the Explore box. Fuel goes to /info-utili, the proposal is submitted, Contattaci goes to /contatti. Item detail: vote labels, Segui 🔔 on venues and Salva ⭐ on events, calendar ICS download (correct UTC times) and Google link. Spotlight: join with a status, a second user sends a wave, the first user sees it in Profilo→Messaggi. Item 'Segnala situazione' works. Guest 'Segnala info errata o abuso' with a reason works. Profile Seguiti/Salvati keep venues and events/posts apart. Account newsletter toggle persists. Register newsletter toggle works. Bacheca: proposal card, post save star, report link, Spotted privacy note text. Vivi: Benzina tile, active themes on top, empty themes show 'Esplora o proponi ✨', proposal card. Admin: tab list correct with no Risposte and no AI button. Archive duplicate opens 'Ripubblica con nuova data' with the date empty and the title prefilled; archive delete works. Inbox: lists, newsletter count, CSV download; contact links editor is under the Contatti sub-tab and its email then shows on /contatti. Benzina & Info CRUD works. Segnalazioni shows Risolta buttons. Price update from /info-utili (comma decimal) re-sorts the list. I fixed one UI bug: the Toggle knob was misplaced.

minor.issue: If at least 3 tonight/weekend events exist, the pool is events only. Today exactly 3 exist, so 'Pesca di nuovo' always returns the same 3 items, just reordered. Suggested fix: always mix in some non-dated items (venues/places/activities) so the reroll changes the results.

They do not clean newsletter, spotlight, live_reports, post_saves/saves/votes, or inbox messages addressed to the user (post_replies where owner_user equals the user, e.g. waves). Orphan records remain (TTL covers spotlight/live only).
It does not check that the item exists and is public (returns an empty list for any id). Low risk.

ui_bugs.component: admin/ui.jsx Toggle (used for register-newsletter-toggle, account-newsletter-toggle, spotlight-toggle, admin 'Visibile' toggles)
ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. The knob had no `left`, so its static position followed the button's text-align:center. It sat about 22px off: in the OFF state it looked ON, and in the ON state it overflowed onto the label text. Added left-0, shrink-0 on the track, text-left, plus role=switch and aria-checked.

issues: Guests see a 'Spotlight ✨ · Accedi per vedere chi c'è qui' teaser card. The spec says guests don't see Spotlight. No people are leaked, but remove the teaser if the spec must be followed strictly.
The live report zone uses a native <select>, and event date/time use native inputs instead of shadcn Select/Calendar (this existed before).

action_items: (minor) /api/surprise: mix non-dated items into the pool so a reroll gives different results when few events exist
(minor) Clean up user-related v3 data (newsletter, spotlight, live_reports, saves, inbox) when deleting a user or account
(optional) Decide whether guests should see the Spotlight teaser at all (spec: hidden for guests)

(test infra) backend/tests/test_cosafare_api.py is the obsolete v1 suite (PIN admin, old spotted API) and fails massively; delete it or rewrite it. test_v2_api's backup/restore test breaks other modules when run under the default pytest.ini xdist -n 2 (each worker has a different RUN id, and a restore drops the other worker's users), so run it with -n 0
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still over 1750 lines and v3.py is 450. Consider splitting server.py (auth, items, board, admin) into routers.
/me/saved-posts does N+1 queries (public_post plus post_saved per id). Use a single $in query.
admin_delete_post does not delete post_saves for that post (they are filtered out at read time, but they pile up).
Reports can target archived/rejected items, since find_one has no status filter. This is acceptable but worth noting.
seed_v3 deletes and re-inserts the 2 seed live reports on every backend start, so they reappear 20/45 minutes old after each hot reload. Fine for a demo; remove before production.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after the Toggle fix (one UI bug found and fixed)

Contact links were reset to empty. Tamoil diesel was restored to 1.672; Esso diesel was restored but now shows updated_by 'redazione'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_v3_api.py backend/tests/test_v2_api.py backend/tests/test_vivi_api.py -n 0. test_v3 uses direct pymongo (mongodb://localhost:27017, test_database) for cleanup. For frontend login, set localStorage cfp_token and then goto. The contact links editor is in Admin → Proposte & Contatti → inbox-tab-contacts (superadmin only). Archive delete uses window.confirm (accept the dialog). The station price form uses price-value-input with a fuel select; it accepts a comma decimal.
